scheme_name: Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank: For Animal Husbandry
other_conditions: Must be engaged in animal husbandry
Must intend to use the loan specifically for animal husbandry (e.g., purchasing buffaloes or goats)
Must be interested to avail the Animal Husbandry Loan
benefits_summary: Provides loans up to ₹20,000 for purchasing two buffaloes or ₹24,500 for purchasing 21 goats at interest rates of 14.5%–16.5%.
